items.docs: The Watch Users operation in the Google Gmail API allows applications to set up push notifications for a user's mailbox by establishing a watch on their Gmail account. When called via POST to /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/watch, this endpoint configures Gmail to send notifications to a specified Cloud Pub/Sub topic whenever changes occur in the user's mailbox, such as receiving new emails, messages being deleted, or labels being modified.
